Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Hi all,
>
>Can i use superior Fata Morgana to increase my bleed if nobody blocks
>me, despite the +1 stealth?
>

No. Even though it's a different card, it's pretty much the same as Bonding.

The superior form of Bonding cannot be used if you do not need the stealth at
the time you play Bonding. [TOM 19951109]

(You need the stealth in order to play Fata Morgana).

Halcyan 2

Well in which order it's written is really irrelevant since the text has the
word "and" which doesn't in any way make text following that secondary to
the first text. If a card said "additional strike and a dodge" it wouldn't
mean you had to play that additional strike first before you could dodge.

vampire before the bleed? But how can it do that when an action card's
effect shouldn't apply until the action is successful? Because if was
bloocked the vampire shouldn't have been tapped.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sorrow wrote:
>
> > >Can i use superior Fata Morgana to increase my bleed if nobody blocks
> > >me, despite the +1 stealth?
> > No, because you don't need the stealth.
>
> Out of curiosity, why is it that you can use 2nd Tradition if you don't need
> the intercept but you can't use Fata Morgana if you don't need the stealth?
> Just seems kind of odd that the ruling/errata was made to 2ndTrad but not
> to this card when it's almost the opposite side of the same coin.

Because 2nd Trad needed errata to correct the introduction of the word
"only" in the V:TES printing. Since it was being errata'ed anyhow, the
other "lesser" fix was also made, since the errata threshold was already
met.

Fata Morgana hasn't met the errata threshold.
